oneOf.description: A `barge_in` (speech over the reply, an interrupt control).
A newer input replaced the call on a latest-input-wins node.
The caller cancelled the call (an RPC or endpoint cancel, a dropped plugin call with no reason given).
The input that started the call was retracted (`CancelSpeculation`).
The session closed while the call ran.

CancelRequest.description:
A cancellation as it crosses a boundary to a node in another library or process (`FfiNode::cancel_call`, a worker's cancel frame). `cancellation` is the host's resolution; `explicit` is what the canceller and manifest chose, so the node can re-resolve with its own default for this cancel (which may depend on `elapsed_ms`, e.g. an early-interrupt rollback).

Wire rule, shared with Python: a request that carries `explicit` or `elapsed_ms` is re-resolved by the node; one with only `cancellation` (or a bare `Cancellation`) is final. `explicit` is therefore always serialized, also when empty.

CancelStrategy.description: How a generator stops a cancelled call.

oneOf.description: All generation happens inside the call future; dropping it stops the work (a streamed HTTP response, an awaited token loop).
Work outside the future polls or subscribes to the call's [`CancelToken`](crate::cancel::CancelToken).
The node stops work out of band in [`Cancellable::on_cancel`] (abort a remote request, stop a model thread), and may also observe the token.

Cancellation.description: A call's cancellation: why, and what to do with data.

Disposition.description: What a cancel does with data.

partial_output.description: What the node does with what it generated before the cancel: commit it to its own state (an LLM keeps the cut-off reply in history, marked interrupted) or roll it back. Output already emitted downstream is never recalled.

pending_input.description: Input already received or queued for the node, including input the node buffered internally: kept for the next call, or dropped.

DispositionOverride.description: A partial disposition, as a canceller (`barge_in` envelope, RPC cancel) or a manifest node's `on_cancel` gives it. Absent fields fall through.

oneOf.description: Includes avatar, lip-sync and motion renderers.

GeneratorDeclaration.description: What a factory, schema or plugin description declares about the role before a node exists. Both `None` declares nothing (not a generator, or a plugin built before this contract).

Retention.description: Keep or drop one kind of data on a cancel.
